meta.name: The Doll
meta.description: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Having made a fortune during the war, Stanisław Wokulski returns to Poland with only one goal in mind – to marry the beautiful Izabela Łęcka.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When Izabela's dreams of traveling to Paris go up in smoke, Stanisław suggests to her father that money is not his only investment resource.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Izabela exploits Stanisław's love to gain an opportunity to fulfill her journalistic ambitions. Marianna begins to take an interest in Ignacy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An unexpected victory boosts Stanisław's ratings and brings him closer to Izabela. However, a poor evaluation of a certain auction could result in the buyer losing significantly.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The pair temporarily bid farewell to Warsaw. Izabela learns what it's like to live on the streets, and Stanisław tries to dig up a larger fortune.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When the truth ceases to be a secret, Stanisław's efforts may prove futile. Will he still be able to achieve what he desires?
